Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC for Computer set 1. Branded Desktop Computer. The desktop computer set shall be of a reputed and established brand such as HP, Dell, Acer, Lenovo or any other equivalent reputed manufacturer. Locally assembled computers or computers carrying non-reputed/local brands shall not be accepted. 2. Complete Computer Set. The supply shall comprise a complete desktop computer set, including the follo wing components: Desktop computer with CPU/tower. Monitor. UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply). Keyboard. Mouse. All necessary cables, connectors and accessories required for installation and operation. 3. Minimum Technical Specifications. The desktop computer shall conform to the following minimum techn ical specifications: Component Minimum specification Processor Intel Core i5, latest available generation or equivalent RAM 16 GB DDR4/DDR5 Storage 512 GB SSD Operating System Genuine, licensed Windows 11 Office Software Genuine, licensed Microsoft Office (latest available version) Monitor Branded LED monitor, minimum 21.5 inches11. After-Sales Service. The firm shall provide necessary after-sales technical support during the warranty period. In case of any technical issue or hardw are malfunction, the firm shall arrange prompt repair or replacement without any additional cost to the ca nteen. Suitable branded UPS with adequate backup Keyboard Branded USB keyboard Mouse Branded USB optical mouse 4. Original Software and Licensing. The operating system and Microsoft Office software shall be genuine, o riginal and duly licensed. Pre-installed or activated licensed software shall be provided along with the com puter. Pirated, trial or unauthorised software shall not be accepted. 5. CIMS Compatibility. The desktop computer shall be fully compatible with the existing Canteen Informati on Management System (CIMS) being operated in the canteen. The firm shall ensure that the supplied har

dware, operating system and other software are suitable for seamless functioning of CIMS without any co mpatibility issues. The firm shall verify the compatibility requirements before supply. 6. Warranty. The complete desktop computer set, including CPU, monitor, UPS and other supplied compon ents, shall carry a minimum comprehensive warranty of two years from the date of installation and accept ance. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, hardware failures and necessary repairs/replaceme nts during the warranty period. 7. Delivery Period. The complete desktop computer set shall be delivered to the designated canteen premi ses within seven days from the date of placement of the supply order. Timely delivery shall be given due i mportance. 8. Suitable branded UPS with adequate backup Keyboard Branded USB keyboard Mouse Branded USB optical mouse 9. Demonstration and User Assistance. The firm's representative shall provide a proper demonstration of t he computer system to the canteen staff, including basic operations, software usage and functioning of CI MS. Necessary assistance shall also be provided to ensure smooth operation of the system. 10. Inspection and Acceptance. The supplied computer set shall be inspected and tested by the authorised representative of the canteen. Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory installation, demonstration and verification of all technical specifications and CIMS compatibility. 11. After-Sales Service. The firm shall provide necessary after-sales technical support during the warranty period. In case of any technical issue or hardware malfunction, the firm shall arrange prompt repair or repl acement without any additional cost to the canteen. 12. Comprehensive Quotation. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all hardware components, genuine lic ensed software, UPS, accessories, transportation, delivery, installation, configuration, demonstration and a ll other incidental expenses. No additional charges shall be admissible on any account. 13. Payment. Payment shall be processed after successful delivery, installation, demonstration and satisfa ctory acceptance of the complete computer set by the authorised representative. 14. Compliance with Specifications. The firm shall ensure that the supplied computer set strictly conforms to the stipulated technical specifications. Any deviation or substitution shall require prior approval of the c ompetent authority. .
